users: Landed Cost Voucher New Selling Price now also re-prices carton/box Item Prices at price x conversion factor (was: set to the unit price). A deliberately discounted carton price is replaced by unit x factor (re-enter the discount after the voucher); customer-specific, batch and validity-window prices are still overwritten as before; a box price in a UOM the item has no conversion for is left untouched; a newly created price carries the stock UOM.

Request Cancellation fast track (draft Delivery Note): only a requester who can read the invoice (role + company) gets the automatic cancel, and the reason must meet the configured minimum length; others go through the normal request flow.

Draft Delivery Note deletion, and the fast-track auto-cancel (new and legacy invoices alike), no longer cancel the Sales Order's Payment Entries: the money stays on the customer's account. When the cancelled Sales Order is amended and resubmitted with its copied payment rows, the kept Payment Entries move to the amendment and only any extra amount is booked (no second receipt). A Sales Order cancelled from the desk still cancels its receipts.

Device check-in endpoint (add_checkin) now requires Employee Checkin create and read on the punched Employee, so Company and Employee User Permissions apply. PRE-DEPLOY GATE: the biometric sync token's user must pass both for every device company (see #174 bench step).
Commission: supplier refunds and other non-Customer Payment Entries no longer count, and no longer require a Sales Person; Payment Entry amounts are counted in company currency.
An invoice whose goods were only partly returned can no longer be cancelled (directly or by deleting another draft DN) until every unit is back; the guard also follows invoice amendments.

DN Returns: the uplift credit note for a price corrected upwards now carries the Sales Person (it was rejected before); returns of delivery-first notes now raise their credit note; rows no invoice can be found for are reported (alert + Error Log).
Changing or clearing an employee's default shift ends the running Shift Assignment the day before instead of cancelling it, so attendance deductions for earlier days stay.
Negative-stock automation counts pack lines in stock units and sums rows of one item, so carton sales no longer fail with Insufficient Stock where the automation should have armed.

Reconcile All needs Stock Reconciliation create permission; the broken-chain audit and the relink repair respect the caller's permissions; the outstanding-debt notice shows foreign-currency receivables in their own currency.
DN Returns: if the price-uplift credit note cannot be raised, the alert and Error Log now state the exact amount still owed.

Outstanding-debt block on Sales Order submit: each receivable account is now judged and shown in its own account currency (a foreign-currency receivable settled in that currency no longer blocks because of an exchange-difference residue in company currency).
release_notes.connector_routes: No kit_pos connector route, response shape or status code is changed; no connector file is touched. The only change on the tills' path is server-side: negative_stock_handler.ensure_negative_stock_for_doc (Sales Invoice before_submit during materialization) now arms for pack lines, i.e. fewer NegativeStockError refusals. The sales-chain cancel guards (#182/#253) only bite where Delivery Notes exist (not on update_stock POS invoices). Round 2 touches no connector file either; add_checkin is not a kit_pos connector route (biometric PHP only).
pre_deploy_gates: #174: confirm the biometric sync token user's roles and User Permissions on the lab copy and replay a 4S and a Vox punch through add_checkin (blocking: otherwise punches 403 forever and the nightly job marks staff Absent).

migrate: none: no DocType schema change, no Custom Field, no fixture, no patch. Only core fields are read (stock_qty, conversion_factor, base_paid_amount, dn_detail, *_in_account_currency, Item Price.uom, Shift Assignment.end_date); safe on ddamu's un-migrated schema.
risks: #174: if the biometric sync token's user lacks Employee Checkin create or Employee read, or is fenced by a Company/Employee User Permission not covering every device company, punches 403 and the PHP retries forever: release gate. Users with the hrms Employee role can still create their own punches (as upstream hrms).

#258: kept receipts are re-pointed (reference_no) to the amended order on its submit; the amount comparison uses paid_amount in the order currency and only PEs with paid_from_account_currency = order currency count. A receipt already allocated to an invoice still counts as covering the amendment (it is the same cash). If the amendment changes customer, the kept PE stays with the old customer as an advance and the new order books its own. The fast track now keeps receipts for legacy invoices too.

#180: Attendance row lock adds a lock to the after_insert path; Kit Attend locks Employee first, the fours endpoint takes only the Attendance lock, so no lock cycle is expected, but the lab should run a concurrent punch burst.
#186: saving end_date on a submitted Shift Assignment runs HRMS on_update_after_submit; assignments HRMS refuses to update are logged and left (as cancel failures were).
#182/#253 make cancellation stricter: some cancels that passed before (partial returns, amendments) are now refused with the existing 'Delivery Note still submitted' message.
All tests here are stub-frappe unit tests; real hooks, ERPNext validation and permissions need the lab rehearsal listed per finding.
open_questions: #173: the fast track audience is 'may read the invoice'. Requiring the auto-cancel role was not done (those users already auto-cancel in the original flow, so the fast track would be dead code); narrow to a dedicated fast-track role?
#183: make the DN-return credit flow atomic? Round 2 reports the exact amount owed instead; atomic would mean refusing the store keeper's return submit.
#165: for carton rows, re-derive from unit x factor (current), or scale by new/old unit price to keep deliberate carton discounts? Skip customer/batch/validity-window rows?
#182: net returns per invoice row instead of per note+item (current behaviour fails closed for notes carrying two invoices)?
#174: rotate the API token hard-coded in biometric-sync-src SendBiometricLogsToERP.php (verifier note; outside this repo).
#256 (minor, left): should the store-only goods-return guard be limited to companies with enable_selling_automations?
